title: Countdown Timer
description: Build a countdown timer that ticks down from a set time and displays MM:SS format.

steps.title: Convert seconds to MM:SS
steps.description: Write a function `formatTime(seconds)` that converts total seconds into `MM:SS` format (e.g., 125 becomes `02:05`).

verification.failureMessage: Make sure formatTime returns MM:SS with leading zeros.

steps.title: Countdown function
steps.description: Write `countdown(seconds)` that logs the current time every second until zero. Use `setInterval` (JS/TS) or `time.sleep` (Python).
hints: Clear interval when reaching zero with clearInterval

codeTemplate.python:
import time

def countdown(seconds):
    # Your code here

countdown(10)

verification.failureMessage: Ensure countdown logs values each second.

steps.title: Timer display format
steps.description: Modify the display so the countdown shows in `HH:MM:SS` format when the duration exceeds one hour.
hints: Reuse formatTime logic for minutes and seconds

steps.title: Calculate time remaining
steps.description: Write `getTimeRemaining(endTime)` that accepts a future date and returns the remaining seconds, minutes, and hours as an object.
hints: Subtract Date.now() from the end time
Use Math.max to prevent negative values

codeTemplate.python:
import time

def get_time_remaining(end_time):
    # Your code here

print(get_time_remaining(time.time() + 5))

verification.failureMessage: Return an object with hours, minutes, seconds.

steps.title: Timer presets
steps.description: Create a `TimerPreset` structure with preset durations (e.g., 5 min, 10 min, 30 min). Add a function `startPreset(minutes)` that initializes the countdown.
hints: Store presets as an array of objects with label and minutes
Map preset button clicks to startPreset
